_doc: Ralph single-slice loop state. Point: SLICE. Location: <repo>/plans/ralph/<yyyy-mm-dd>-<slice>/state.json (RELATIVE to project repo root, committed there -- NOT ~/.pi). No captain, no waves, no DAG -- one unit of work iterated until acceptance passes. Orchestrator handles state + resume. Reports to USER (not captain), so escalation may reach the user. Design ref: pi config docs/design/2026-07-01-fleet-ralph-state-schema.md.
_instantiate: Planner/orchestrator fills sliceName, branch, faultTolerance + assignment, and acceptance. Orchestrator updates step/impl/review/assumptions each iteration.

branchStrategy._doc: Ditetapkan di awal ralph run (deteksi + konfirmasi), dipakai seluruh loop. Resume anchor. RALPH matrix: trunk+flag -> langsung merge+push base; trunk-no-flag -> PR/MR setelah selesai; classic -> tanya checkout dari mana + PR/MR ke base.

prTooling._doc: Orchestrator probe di awal saat integration=pr-mr. CLI tak wajib; gagal -> print URL di akhir.

_escalation_boundary: Ralph runs with SOME user presence (semi-attended). Orchestrator decides in-boundary + records assumption; escalates to user when a decision crosses the slice boundary / contract. If a superior model (e.g. opus reviewer) says a blocker cannot be passed, STOP the loop.

assignment._default_mapping: low -> implementer-critical + deep-reviewer ; standard -> implementer + reviewer ; trivial -> implementer-lite + reviewer
assignment._ratchet: upgrade-only, never downgrade. low-tolerance never silently downgraded on resume.

loop._doc: Ralph iterates until acceptance passes or a hard blocker stops the loop.

acceptance._doc: The pass/fail gate command for this slice (real, runnable). Loop continues until this passes.

assumptions._boundary: crossed slice boundary? -> parked question for user instead of self-decide.

parkedQuestions.question: decision that crosses the slice boundary -- needs user
